title: Production Canvas
lede: Persistent project canvas for stage status, sources, prompts, media, review, and selection.

stages.label: Brief and development
stages.summary: Capture the production objective, constraints, and directing choices.

stages.label: Scene and production breakdown
stages.summary: Inventory scenes, shots, cast, locations, props, dialogue, and sound needs.

stages.label: Canon and elements
stages.summary: Review recurring characters, locations, props, screens, cards, and audio elements.

stages.label: Storyboard and visual plan
stages.summary: Review shot geography, boards, prompts, continuity, and video eligibility.

stages.label: Audio preparation
stages.summary: Review requested dialogue, music, effects, timing, and audio inspection evidence.

stages.label: Shot generation
stages.summary: Compare takes with exact prompts, ordered references, provenance, and QA.

stages.label: Assembly and review
stages.summary: Review approved inputs, edits, continuity, transitions, and sound.

stages.label: Delivery
stages.summary: Inspect masters, proxies, localization, metadata, hashes, and approval.
